An autothermal reaction is one in which the heat generated by the reaction is used to sustain it. If the heat generated is insufficient, the reaction might not be able to maintain the required temperature, leading to a decrease in reaction rate. Ultimately, if the reaction cannot sustain the required energy, it may stop, as there isn't enough heat to keep it going.
